top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength optical lattice clock (Katori, Ye) is a distinct measurement principle, not a refinement of the 2005 comb or 2012 ion prizes: many neutral atoms interrogated at once, free of Doppler, recoil and light-shift errors, reaching ~1e-18 verified across several laboratories and enabling millimetre-scale redshift tests. The two-name allocation is clean and the work is mature and reproducible. P001 is a strong, well-structured alternative, but its attribution is harder to contain in three names and the pairing mechanism remains open; an award is still preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No conflict for P002 or P001 apparent from profile; as WACQT director and a close colleague of superconducting-circuit groups (Delsing, Wilson, Wallraff, Schoelkopf, Blais) I would recuse on B040, which is not in this slate.
